purpose: Describes step-by-step how the AI analysis pipeline works, without source code or credentials

core_concept.name: The Reality Gap
core_concept.description: The scanner detects the gap between what a company SAYS it is (Intent) and what independent EVIDENCE shows it actually is (Reality).
core_concept.formula: Reality Gap = Intent Score - Reality Score

interpretations.large_positive_gap_with_washing: High-risk signal: ambitious promises, weak operations
interpretations.negative_gap: Humble company: under-communicates its actual capabilities

three_layer_strategy.layer_3_synthesis: Cross-verify both + reconcile the gap (wisdom layer)

knowledge_base.description: A centralized framework that grounds ALL analysis. Defines vocabulary, dimensions, archetypes, and patterns. Ensures consistency across scans and prevents AI from inventing its own categories.

five_dimensions.name: Operating Model
five_dimensions.good_signals: Autonomy, stream-aligned teams, flow efficiency, platform teams

five_dimensions.name: Strategy
five_dimensions.good_signals: Adaptive, customer-centric, digital transformation with execution
five_dimensions.bad_signals: Static, top-down, cost-cutting only, no digital roadmap

five_dimensions.name: Culture & Values
five_dimensions.good_signals: Psychological safety, learning culture, trust, talent retention
five_dimensions.bad_signals: Compliance-driven, fear culture, high turnover, control

five_dimensions.name: AI Readiness
five_dimensions.good_signals: Data platforms, ML adoption, R&D publications, augmentation
five_dimensions.bad_signals: Spreadsheets, legacy systems, AI buzzwords without adoption

four_archetypes.name: Modernizing
four_archetypes.meaning: Strong operations but financial pressure. Investing in transformation, returns not yet materialized.

four_archetypes.name: Cash Cow
four_archetypes.meaning: Profitable but operationally outdated. Making money from legacy advantages. Accumulating technical debt.

four_archetypes.name: At Risk
four_archetypes.meaning: Both operations and finances under pressure. Status quo unsustainable.

phase_1_intent_analysis.name: Scanner 1: Intent Analysis
phase_1_intent_analysis.question: How ambitious is this company's narrative compared to typical companies?

thinking_process.step_1: Scan text for positive ('modernization') and negative ('legacy') keywords per Knowledge Base dimension
thinking_process.step_2: Apply negation detection: 'we avoid waterfall' does NOT count as negative signal
thinking_process.step_3: Apply word-boundary matching: prevent partial word false positives
thinking_process.step_5: Normalize for text length (short docs not penalized, long docs not inflated)
thinking_process.step_6: Calculate Friction Index (0-1): degree of mixed/contradictory signals

outputs.per_dimension_breakdown: Individual scores + matched keywords per dimension

accuracy_safeguards: Negation detection prevents false positives
Word boundary checks prevent partial matches
Short vs long text normalization prevents length bias
High friction index flags contradictory messaging
phase_1_intent_analysis.model_used: Rule-based keyword analysis (no AI model needed)

phase_2_reality_check.name: Scanner 2: Reality Check (5-Jury Model)
phase_2_reality_check.question: What does independent external evidence show about this company's actual operational maturity?

step_1_jury_search.description: Five independent 'juries' each search for evidence in a different area using AI with live web search grounding

juries.jury_1_architecture: GitHub repos, engineering blogs, tech stacks, job postings. Modern vs legacy architecture evidence.
juries.jury_2_strategy: Annual reports, financial databases, investments. Are they investing in digital transformation?
juries.jury_3_culture: Glassdoor, LinkedIn hiring patterns, meetup sponsorships. Can they retain talent?
juries.jury_4_ai_data: Hugging Face models, tech stacks, cloud case studies, academic papers. Real ML adoption or pilot purgatory?
juries.jury_5_service_portfolio: Service pages, case studies, analyst reports. Can they deliver modern services?

scoring.technical_debt_penalty: -20 to -35 for evidence of legacy/manual workarounds
scoring.near_zero_evidence_penalty: -35 to -50 if almost no evidence across all juries

step_2_confidence_driven_research.process: Identify weak juries, build broader search terms, re-search, merge new findings
step_2_confidence_driven_research.stop_condition: Confidence >= 45 or no new evidence found

step_3_evidence_validation.description: Every evidence URL verified via HTTP request
step_3_evidence_validation.dead_link_threshold: If >20% dead, trigger URL Recovery Re-Search

step_4_delta_verification.trigger: Score changed >= 15 points from previous scan
step_4_delta_verification.process: Run entire search again to verify
step_4_delta_verification.if_both_agree: Accept as genuine change, average the two scores

step_5_evidence_persistence.behavior: Previous findings carry forward for 90 days
step_5_evidence_persistence.rationale: Not re-finding something = search noise, not improvement

washing_detection.condition: Intent > 60 AND Reality significantly below Intent
types: AI Washing: AI buzzwords without real adoption evidence
Agile Washing: Claims modern practices, evidence of waterfall
Green Washing: ESG narrative without sustainable operations evidence
safety_checks: Cannot flag washing if Intent < 40 (low ambition can't be called washing)
Re-checked after score verification: if Reality >= Intent, washing removed

outputs.checklist: Per-jury findings with sentiment, recency, source type
outputs.evidence_links: Verified URLs with titles, snippets, domains
outputs.key_people: Executives mentioned in evidence (name, role, relevance)
outputs.confidence_score: 0-100, how much evidence supports the assessment

accuracy_safeguards: 5 independent juries ensure diverse evidence
All evidence URLs verified via HTTP
Dead link recovery prevents false low scores
Delta verification re-scans prevent noise from single-run search variance
Evidence persistence prevents lucky re-scans from hiding real problems
Recency weighting ensures stale evidence doesn't dominate
phase_2_reality_check.model_used: Sonnet 4.6 with Extended Thinking + Brave Web Search (primary, 10 searches), Gemini 3.1 Pro with Google Search grounding (fallback, fact-check + inline correction)

phase_2b_financial_health.name: Financial Health Index
phase_2b_financial_health.question: How financially healthy is this company?

core_health_gate.description: If both Revenue and Profitability are weak, composite score is dampened regardless of Efficiency/Investment
core_health_gate.floor: 25% of weighted base when fundamentals are weak
core_health_gate.fully_open: When Revenue + Profitability reach 60% of maximum

outputs.sub_scores: Revenue Trend, Profitability, Efficiency, Investment Signal (each 0-25)
outputs.financial_findings: Per-dimension evidence with quotes and sources

phase_2b_financial_health.non_blocking: If Financial search fails, scan continues with Financial = null

phase_2c_self_analysis.name: Self-Analysis Loop
phase_2c_self_analysis.trigger: Score changed >= 15 points within 7 days of previous scan
phase_2c_self_analysis.question: Why did the scanner produce different results? Search variance, evidence gaps, prompt sensitivity, or genuine change?

pre_computed_diagnostics.source_diversity: Unique domains in evidence, single-domain dominance detection
pre_computed_diagnostics.jury_coverage: Which juries had evidence, which were empty
pre_computed_diagnostics.evidence_recency: Ratio of recent (<12mo) vs old findings
pre_computed_diagnostics.url_overlap: Shared URLs between previous and current scan (low overlap < 20% = strong search variance indicator)

root_cause_classification: search_variance: Different Google results each time (most common)
evidence_gap: One scan found sources the other missed
prompt_sensitivity: Same evidence, model interpreted differently
genuine_change: Real company change (unlikely within 7 days)

phase_3_synthesis.name: Synthesis & Cross-Verification
phase_3_synthesis.question: Do independent scores validate Scanner 1/2? What is the diagnosis and executive pitch?

part_1_blind_scoring.description: Senior AI model reads ALL evidence but WITHOUT seeing Scanner scores. Independently evaluates Reality and Intent.
part_1_blind_scoring.reality_scoring: Scores each of 5 KB dimensions independently (0-20 each). No evidence = 10 (neutral).

part_2_cross_verification.delta_6_to_10: Mild disagreement: Blended average (60% Scanner, 40% Synthesis)

part_3_narrative.diagnosis: 180-220 words. States archetype, maps findings to KB dimensions, uses KB terminology.
part_3_narrative.pitch: 90-110 words. C-level cold-outreach with exactly 2 concrete proposals from weakest KB dimensions.

fallback_chain: Claude Opus 4.6 with Extended Thinking (primary, 10K thinking budget)
accuracy_safeguards: Extended Thinking: Opus reasons through conflicting evidence before scoring
Blind verification: Synthesis scores without seeing Scanner scores
Blending logic prevents any single model from dominating
Post-verification: if Reality >= Intent, washing flag removed
4-model fallback chain ensures synthesis completes under API pressure

phase_3b_fact_check.name: Fact-Check & Evidence Integrity Gate
phase_3b_fact_check.runs: Immediately after Phase 3 Synthesis, before Archetype Classification
phase_3b_fact_check.question: Are the claims in the AI-generated summary actually true? Is the evidence contaminated?
phase_3b_fact_check.core_insight: The problem is EVIDENCE CONTAMINATION, not hallucination. Checking the summary against stored evidence is circular when the evidence itself may be wrong. An independent model with live web search must verify claims against the real world.

step_1_heuristic_hallucination_detection.description: Rule-based pre-scan of the summary and pitch for obvious red flags
checks: Summary references people not found in evidence
Summary makes claims with no supporting evidence links
Pitch contains generic template language instead of company-specific proposals
Confidence score is low but summary sounds certain
step_1_heuristic_hallucination_detection.output: Hallucination risk score (0-100) + specific flags. Diagnostic only — does NOT block the pipeline.

step_2_ai_fact_check.description: Gemini 3.1 Pro with Google Search grounding independently verifies every factual claim in the summary and pitch against live web data
step_2_ai_fact_check.model: Gemini 3.1 Pro with Google Search grounding
process: Receives the full summary text, pitch text, evidence links, and company name
Uses Google Search to independently verify each factual claim
Classifies each claim as verified (true) or false
If false claims found: produces a corrected summary and pitch in the same call (inline correction)
step_2_ai_fact_check.single_pass_guarantee: The fact-check runs exactly ONCE. No recursive loops. The fact-checker fixes what it finds in a single pass.

step_3_if_clean.description: No false claims found — original synthesis stands as-is. Pipeline continues to Archetype Classification.

step_4_if_false_claims_found.description: False claims detected — triggers evidence purging and summary correction

sub_steps.a_evidence_purging: Remove contaminated evidence sources that supported the false claims from stored data (links, checklist items)
sub_steps.b_apply_corrected_summary: Use the corrected summary/pitch produced by the fact-checker (preferred path — inline correction)
sub_steps.c_fallback_re_synthesis: If the fact-checker did not produce a corrected summary, trigger a separate full re-synthesis from cleaned evidence using the Gemini model chain. The re-synthesis prompt explicitly lists the false claims to avoid.
sub_steps.d_clear_stale_flags: Remove washing flags that may have been based on now-purged false claims

outputs.verified: Boolean — did the summary pass fact-check?
outputs.false_claims: List of specific false claims detected (if any)
outputs.false_claims_detailed: Per-claim details with evidence source mapping
outputs.corrected_summary: Fact-checker-produced corrected summary (if false claims found)
outputs.corrected_pitch: Fact-checker-produced corrected pitch (if false claims found)
outputs.fact_check_time_ms: Time taken for the fact-check call
outputs.evidence_purged: Count and details of removed contaminated evidence sources

accuracy_safeguards: Independent model (Gemini) with live web search — not checking summary against its own evidence (avoids circular validation)
Single-pass guarantee prevents infinite fact-check loops
Evidence purging removes the root cause (contaminated sources), not just the symptom (bad text)
Inline correction by the same model that found the errors ensures consistency
Fallback re-synthesis path ensures correction even if inline correction fails
Washing flags cleared after correction to prevent stale false-positive flags

phase_4_archetype_classification.name: Company Archetype Determination
phase_4_archetype_classification.fallback: If Financial unavailable, Intent Score used as proxy

phase_5_multi_scan_history.name: Longitudinal Trend Analysis
phase_5_multi_scan_history.question: How has this company evolved? Are issues persistent, resolving, or escalating?
phase_5_multi_scan_history.lookback: Up to 3 previous scans (rolling 12-scan history window)

rescan_verification.resolved: Found new counter-evidence proving claim now fixed
rescan_verification.unverified: No evidence either way — carried forward as-is

phase_6_statistical_analysis.name: Cross-Company Statistical Intelligence
phase_6_statistical_analysis.trigger: On-demand, analyzes all scanned companies together
analyses: Descriptive statistics: median, IQR, mean, std, skew per score type
Correlation analysis: Spearman (primary), Kendall's Tau, Pearson (reference)
Full correlation matrix: Intent × Reality × Financial × Confidence
Archetype distribution: count and percentage per archetype
Regression residuals: which companies deviate most from expected Reality-Financial relationship
Domain breakdown: average scores by industry vertical
Ownership breakdown: average scores by ownership type
Top 10 / Bottom 10: ranked by Reality Score
phase_6_statistical_analysis.why_non_parametric: Score distributions are often skewed. Spearman and Kendall are robust to outliers and non-normality. Pearson included only as reference.

verification_mechanisms.summary: Seven layers of accuracy assurance operate across the entire pipeline

layers.name: Jury Diversity
layers.description: Five independent evidence hunts. Confidence requires 3+ juries with evidence.

layers.name: Evidence Validation
layers.description: Every URL verified via HTTP. Dead links trigger recovery. Remaining dead links penalize confidence.

layers.name: Blind Cross-Verification
layers.description: Synthesis model scores independently without seeing Scanner scores. Disagreements trigger blending or override.

layers.name: AI Fact-Check (Post-Synthesis)
layers.description: Gemini 3.1 Pro with Google Search independently verifies every claim in the summary against live web data. False claims trigger evidence purging and corrected summary. Single-pass guarantee prevents recursive loops.

layers.name: Score Drift Guard
layers.description: Limits score changes to ±15 per 7-day window. Large changes trigger self-analysis diagnostic.

layers.name: Evidence Persistence
layers.description: Previous findings carry forward for 90 days. Not re-finding something = search noise, not improvement.

layers.name: Logic Consistency
layers.description: Post-verification checks: washing impossible if Reality >= Intent. Archetype recalculated from final verified scores.
